hero.title: Coworking 2.0
hero.subtitle: The evolution of the traditional coworking model towards a more decentralized, emotional, personalized and data-driven experience.

evolution.title: Beyond Traditional Coworking
evolution.subtitle: Coworking 2.0 is not just about offering shared desks, it's about creating an intelligent ecosystem that adapts to the real needs of remote workers, digital nomads and hybrid professionals.
evolution.description: The traditional model of fixed physical spaces is evolving into ubiquitous experiences that adapt to context, creating a global community connected by interests rather than just location.

comparison.title: Coworking 1.0 vs 2.0
comparison.subtitle: A fundamental shift in how we think about workspace

community.title: Community
community.coworking_1: People who happen to be in the same place

usage_model.title: Usage Model
usage_model.coworking_2: Flexible access, by use, day or purpose

environment.title: Environment
environment.coworking_2: Adaptive according to intention and energy

value_measurement.title: Value Measurement
value_measurement.coworking_2: Impact on productivity, wellbeing and connection

decentralization.title: Decentralization & Ubiquity
decentralization.description: Work no longer revolves around an office, but around places that enhance your mental state and daily goals. You can work from a café, park or library depending on how you feel or what you need to achieve.

context.title: Context & Purpose
context.description: It's not about where you are, but why you're there. The ideal space for deep focus is not the same as for creative brainstorming.

real_time_data.title: Real-time Data
real_time_data.description: Live information about noise, occupancy, place energy, connectivity, etc. Dynamic recommendations based on your profile, history and community behavior.

gamification.title: Gamification & Community
gamification.description: Contributing to the platform has benefits: status, rewards, impact. Coworking becomes a collective experience where everyone contributes.

scalability.title: Scalability without Infrastructure
scalability.description: Unlike physical coworking chains, Coworking 2.0 can scale globally without needing to acquire spaces. Uses technology, community and partnerships with local businesses.

relevance.title: Why is it Relevant Now?
relevance.subtitle: The perfect storm for a new paradigm

workforce_growth.title: Remote Workforce Growth
workforce_growth.description: The remote workforce is growing rapidly, and more than 70% of workers value location flexibility as a key benefit.

experience_demand.title: Experience-Driven Demand
experience_demand.description: People seek work experiences aligned with their wellbeing, emotional energy and daily goals.

traditional_shortfall.title: Traditional Model Shortfall
traditional_shortfall.description: The traditional coworking model falls short of this new demand, creating an opportunity for innovation.

coffi_leadership.title: Coffi Leading the Revolution
coffi_leadership.subtitle: How Coffi is positioned to create and lead this worldwide trend

vision.title: Creating the Future
vision.description: Coffi is not just adapting to Coworking 2.0 - we are creating it. Our platform embodies all the key elements of this evolution.

technology.title: Technology Foundation
technology.description: Real-time data collection, AI-powered recommendations, and intelligent matching between users and spaces based on context and purpose.

community.title: Global Community
community.description: Building a network that transcends physical boundaries, connecting people through shared interests, work styles, and goals.

partnerships.title: Strategic Partnerships
partnerships.description: Collaborating with local businesses to create a decentralized network without the overhead of owning physical spaces.

data_driven.title: Data-Driven Intelligence
data_driven.description: Our platform learns from user behavior, preferences, and outcomes to continuously improve recommendations and space optimization.

emotional_intelligence.title: Emotional Intelligence
emotional_intelligence.description: Understanding not just what users need, but how they feel and what energy they require for optimal productivity.

contextual_awareness.title: Contextual Awareness
contextual_awareness.description: Matching users with spaces based on their current task, mood, time of day, and personal productivity patterns.
